items.title: Pay roof gutter invoice
items.computation: Invoice date (event starting the period) is 20.11.2026. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the event is not counted, so counting starts 21.11.2026. A 30-day period from that start ends on 20.12.2026 (21-30 Nov = 10 days, 1-20 Dec = 20 days, total 30 days). 20.12.2026 is a Sunday. This is a payment to a company (not an authority), so under §270 Abs.4 / §193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next working day using the payer's own Land (NW). 21.12.2026 (Monday) is not a public holiday in NW, so the due date moves to 21.12.2026.
